name: column: words that ask for a drawing of what was just said. They count only as a follow-up, after an answer: the same words as a first question are an ordinary ask. "Can you draw how these steps connect?" names what the drawing should show and does not count; nor do the words that ask for the whole thing drawn, which are their own ask. A longer line that holds "draw ... diagram" counts as a follow-up too, and the model then decides whether what it explained is a list of steps
